paragraphs: I'm a CSE undergraduate who learns by building and sharing. I have built web applications along with microcontroller and sensor-based projects, and I have used machine learning and deep learning models for classification and detection.
I choose tools to fit the problem and favor the simplest approach that works. I practice problem solving on LeetCode every day.
